spans.s:
mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Viscous, thick, adhesive, as clarified butter, &c.
n. (-नं)
Smoke.
E.
श्यै to go, aff. क्त.

r. 10th cl. (स्यनयते)
To think, to consider, to reflect.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Flowing, dropping, or trickling.
E.
स्यन्द to drop, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Black or dark-blue.
2 Green.
m. (-मः)
1 A sacred fig tree at Prayāga or

Allahabad.
2

A cloud.
3 The Kokila or Indian cuckoo.
4 A potherb, (Convolvulus argenteus.)
5 Black, (the colour.)
6 Green, (the colour.)
7 Thorn-apple, (Datura metel.)
mf. (-मः-मा)
A sort of grain, (Panicum frumentaceum).
n. (-मं)
1

Pepper.
2

Sea salt.
f. (-मा)
1 A woman, described as one who has not borne children; also described as a female of slender make; or one from eight to sixteen; or one who resembles in darkness of complexion, the blossom of the Priyangu, or its stalk, in shape.
2

Night.
3

Shade, shadow.
4 The Jumnā river.
5 A form of

DURGĀ.
6
A plant, commonly

Priyangu.
7

A sort of Convolvulus, (C. turpethum,) with black flowers.
8 A medicinal plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.)
9

Indigo.
10

A twining shrub, (Ichnocarpus frutescens.)
11

Turmeric.
12

Holy basil.
12 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.)
14 A shrub, (Abrus precatorius.)
15 A small singing bird with black plumage, commonly Shāma, (Turdus macrourus.)
16 A cow.
E.
श्यै to go, Uṇādi aff. मक्.

(उ) स्यमु r. 6th cl. (स्यमति)
To sound.
r. 10th cl. (स्यमयति-ते)
To consider, to think.

m. (-कः)
A sort of grain, (Panicum frumentaceum, &c.)
E.
श्यामा the same, कन् added, m. form.

m. (-कः)
A kind of grain generally eaten by the Hindus, (Panicum frumentaceum; also P. colonum.)
E.
श्यामा the same, कन् added, and the final retained.

m. (-ण्ठः)
1 A peacock.
2 Ś

IVA.
3

A small kind of bird.
E.
श्याम black or blue, कण्ठ the throat.

n. (-त्वं)
Blackness.
E.
त्व added to श्याम; also with तल्, श्यामता.

m. (-त्रः)
The Tamāla tree, (Xanthocymus pictorius.)
E.
श्याम black, and पत्र a leaf.

mfn. (-भाः-भाः-भः)
Black as jet, of a glossy black hue.
E.
श्याम, and भास् shining.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Of a black or dark-blue colour.
m. (-लः)
1 Black, (the colour.)
2 Black-pepper.
3 The religious fig tree.
4 A large bee.
f. (-ला)
A name of PĀRVATĪ.
E.
श्याम black, ला to have, aff. क.

f. (-ता)
A climbing plant, (Ichnocarpus frutescens.)
E.
श्याम, and लता a creeper.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
Black-bodied, black.
m. (-ङ्गः)
The planet MERCURY or its ruler.
E.
श्याम black, and अङ्ग the body.

f. (-जा)
Worship of ŚYĀMĀ or DURGĀ, on the new moon of Kārttika.
E.
श्यामा, and पूजा worship.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Blackened, turned or become black.
E.
श्याम, and इतच् aff.

m. (-लः)
A wife's brother.
f. (-ली)
A wife's sister.
E.
श्यै to go, aff. कालन्.

m. (-लः)
A wife's brother.
E.
स्यम to consider, aff. अच्, and म changed to ल; also स्याल.

m. (-कः)
A wife's brother.
f. (-लिका-लकी)
A wife's sister.
E.
कन् added to the last.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Of a brown colour.
m. (-वः)
Brown, (the colour.)
E.
श्यै to go, व aff., deriv. irr.

m. (-लः)
The mango tree.
E.
श्याव brown, and तैल oil.

mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्)
Dark or black toothed, (naturally so.)
E.
श्याव dark or brown, दतृ for दन्त a tooth; also श्यावदन्त and श्यावदन्तक.

m. (-दः)
Speed, velocity.
E.
स्यन्द to go, घञ् aff., and the nasal rejected.

(ऊ) स्यन्दू r. 1st cl. (स्यन्दते)
1 To sprinkle, to drop, to ooze or distil.
2 To go.
With अनु prefixed,
अनुष्यन्दते or अनुस्यन्दते
to drop, &c.; the sibilant being optionally changed after this and other prepositions.

m. (-न्दः)
1 Oozing, trickling.
2 Going, moving.
3 A car, a chariot.
E.
स्यन्द to go, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Quick, expeditious.
m. (-नः)
1 A warchariot.
2 A tree, (Dalbergia ougeinensis.)
3 A Jina of the past era.
4 Air, wind.
n. (-नं)
1 Dropping, oozing, trickling.
2

Water.
3

Going swiftly.
f. (-नी)
Saliva.
E.
स्यन्द to go, युच् or ल्युट् aff.

m. (-मः)
A timber tree, (Dalbergia ougeinensis.)
E.
स्यन्दन a car, and द्रुम a tree; the wood being used to make wheels, &c.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
Mounted on or riding in a car.
E.
स्यन्दन, and आरूढ ascended.

m. (-हः)
A warrior who fights in a car.
E.
स्यन्दन a war-chariot, and आरोह who ascends.

m. (-निः)
A tree, (Dalbergia ougeinensis.)
E.
स्यन्दन a car, ञि aff.

mfn. (-न्दी-न्दिनी-न्दि)
1 Oozing, trickling, dropping.
2 Going, moving.
f. (-न्दिनी)
1

Saliva.
2

A cow bearing twins.
E.
स्यन्द to drop or flow, aff. णिनि.

m. (-कः)
The gem worn by KṚṢṆA.

m. (-कः)
1 An ant-hill.
2 A tree.
3

Time.
4

A cloud.
f. (-का)
Indigo.
E.
स्यम to sound, कन् Uṇādi aff. with ईट् augment; also with इट्, स्यमिक.

ind.
It may be: implying doubt, as स्यादस्ति, स्यान्नास्ति it may be, it may not be.
E.
the verbal conditional form used as a particle.
